scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,ml -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @samvedna/web dev" "pnpm --filter @samvedna/api dev" "pnpm --filter @samvedna/ml-service dev"
scripts.dev:clean: for p in 3000 4000 8001; do lsof -ti :$p | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; done; pnpm dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @samvedna/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @samvedna/web build && pnpm --filter @samvedna/api build
